summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only validation of CoinArchive routing (Home + /coins listing + /coins/:slug detail). Tested 33 review checkpoints across home regression, navigation, filters/search/sort, URL deep-linking, detail page interactions, language toggle, and mobile responsiveness. 32/33 PASSED. Single HIGH-priority bug: nav-logo uses <a href='#top'> instead of react-router <Link to='/'>, so it does NOT return to home from /coins or /coins/:slug — it just appends #top to the current URL. Everything else (hero-explore, hero-browse, feature-read-story, country-card-*, recent-card-*, timeline-browse-year, nav-coins, all 24-card grid + chip filtering + year/mint selects + sort + Berlin search + empty state for DE+2007+J + clear filters + ?country=FR deep-link, obverse/reverse toggle with aria-pressed, breadcrumb with Germany/2019, 9 specs rows, related coins navigation, back button, unknown-slug not-found, EN/DE toggle changing title to 'Mauerfall', mobile no horizontal overflow on both routes) works as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: nav-logo is <a href="#top"> instead of a react-router <Link to="/">. From /coins or /coins/:slug clicking the logo does not return to home — it stays on the current path and only appends #top. Review checkpoint 'Clicking nav-logo navigates to / (home)' FAILS.

issues: Coin images are still generic stock photos (gold bars, piggy bank, hands stacking coins) shared across many slugs — Paris 2024 card shows an airport/runway photo, Italo Calvino shows a piggy bank. Same obverse/reverse image is reused across countries. Non-blocking but inconsistent with a museum-grade numismatic archive. Carried over from previous iterations.

action_items: Fix nav-logo: change /app/frontend/src/components/site/Navbar.jsx line 48 from `<a href="#top" data-testid={HOME.navLogo} ...>` to `<Link to="/" data-testid={HOME.navLogo} ...>` so the logo navigates to home from any route. Add react-router Link import if not already present.

OPTIONAL: Replace shared stock-photo images in /app/frontend/src/data/coinData.js with authentic 2-Euro coin photography per slug — currently every Paris/Calvino/Cáceres card shows unrelated stock imagery, which undermines the archive's credibility.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar logo: hard-coded `<a href="#top">` defeats SPA routing. Must be a react-router Link. This is the only blocker found.

Browsers throw a React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The select still functions but the warning is noisy. If it persists in prod build, refactor the option label to a single string literal (e.g., template literal already, but the editor wrapper is the culprit — flag for build-time exclusion).
Same hero-coin testid-on-div pattern from iteration 2 still present (testid on wrapper div, not img). Carried over.

Mobile menu does not render nav-coins/nav-countries testids — overlay uses separate DOM (carried over from iteration 2). Consider adding mobile-nav-coins testid for completeness, but not blocking the current task.

rca of the issue: nav-logo bug RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/site/Navbar.jsx line 48 renders the logo as `<a href="#top" data-testid={HOME.navLogo}>`. The anchor '#top' is interpreted as an in-page fragment by the browser, so on /coins the URL becomes /coins#top (no route change). Repro: open /coins → click logo → URL becomes /coins#top, page stays on listing. Mitigation: replace the <a href="#top"> with `<Link to="/" data-testid={HOME.navLogo}>` (import Link from 'react-router-dom'). Same fix needed everywhere the logo is used inside the SPA.
